checks.name: Additive fresh/old migrations are idempotent and preserve teacher facts
State event outbox commit atomically
Exact retry is idempotent and differing duplicate is rejected
Gap cannot partially advance state
Injected outbox write failure rolls back event and projection
Existing owner cannot be overwritten while active
Cross-session and oversized IPC cursors rejected
Snapshot and bounded ordered catch-up expose only committed events
Cold recovery settles active process unknown without executing tools
Late owner callback after recovery/new owner cannot write
Commit before notification; dropped UI notification remains pullable
Rejected persistence barrier prevents next effect and emits no success
Missing transaction capability fails closed
Receiver repairs gaps and duplicates without losing order
Navigation epoch prevents stale pull from changing new session
Malformed replay page cannot advance cursor and asks for snapshot
Transient persistence failure does not advance a committed cursor
Tail polling recovers a lost terminal notification with no successor
Tail probes target the active run without scanning historical runs
Burst reasoning batches actual SQLite commits and flushes complete content before tool admission
A failure inside a 128-row insert rolls back the whole batch, and exact retry preserves every event
Queued small batches coalesce without crossing a private-write fence or changing the frozen terminal
Snapshot observation waits for queued lifecycle commits without draining a pending text batch

scope: Real local SQLite transaction and public-event receiver boundaries; no model/provider/UI acceptance
